A1.justification: Both PDFs contain readable main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. They describe the same work, renamed from WASUP to SIC, and retained material can be matched despite substantial layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on Pascal VOC, Stanford Dogs, and RSNA, including accuracy results in Table A.2 and explanation case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains those experiments and adds SIC results on FunnyBirds, further baseline comparisons, and quantitative explanation evaluations.

M1.justification: The B-cos encoder, nonnegative feature representation, similarity aggregation, k-means support selection, and binary cross-entropy training remain unchanged. Renaming WASUP to SIC and newly documenting visualization smoothing do not establish a substantive method revision.

E1.justification: v2 adds FunnyBirds, a synthetic dataset of 50 bird classes with known constituent parts. Its controlled part modifications and background evaluation substantially expand coverage beyond the retained natural-image and chest-radiograph tasks.

E2.justification: v1's Table A.2 compares WASUP only against black-box models. v2 adds evaluated comparisons with ProtoPNet, BagNet17, B-cos, and NW-Head, with NW-Head restricted to Stanford Dogs and RSNA. FunnyBirds also compares SIC against ProtoPNet, BagNet, and B-cos.

E3.justification: v2 introduces controlled FunnyBirds explanation tests and metrics for completeness, correctness, contrastivity, and background independence. Its new training configuration uses 100 epochs and batch size 8. Existing splits and tabulated configurations are retained; the newly introduced wording '(balanced) accuracy' does not clearly identify which evaluations use balancing.

E4.justification: v2 adds systematic explanation analyses using part removal or replacement and background checks, plus two FunnyBirds case studies in Figure A.7. These substantially supplement v1's qualitative examples and latent-space analyses, which are retained under new figure numbers.

E5.justification: v1's Table A.2 explicitly cautions that the RSNA accuracy difference needs confirmation through repeatability experiments with different random initializations; v2 removes that uncertainty statement. Neither version reports run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests, and no change in performed repetitions is established.

E6.justification: v2 adds 14 baseline-result rows in Table A.2 and the FunnyBirds results in Table A.4. SIC reports FunnyBirds accuracy 0.99, background independence 0.99, completeness 0.97, correctness 0.72, and contrastivity 0.95. All ten original accuracy entries in Table A.2 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendices A.1-A.2 retain the same six axiom arguments and support-vector/ReLU reasoning. The mathematical method descriptions are equivalent despite renumbering and reformatting; omission of the displayed standard binary cross-entropy formula does not remove a theoretical result.

C1.justification: The central claim of an inherently interpretable classifier providing faithful local and global explanations is retained. v2 adds practical FunnyBirds validation as an explicit contribution and extends its headline performance claims to comparisons against established interpretable models.

C2.justification: v2 interprets FunnyBirds scores as evidence of background resilience, discriminative feature learning, and feature coverage, and suggests unnormalized part size may limit correctness. It removes v1's discussion of optional per-support explanation decomposition and its complexity tradeoff, while retaining the support-vector overhead limitation.

D1.justification: v2 documents FunnyBirds hyperparameters, default preprocessing, and evaluation with unsmoothed explanations. It also specifies visualization smoothing with a size-nine averaging kernel, NW-Head's replace-cluster mode, and ProtoPNet's implementation source and multi-label adaptation. Existing implementation and dataset-processing details are largely retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Hesse et al.'s FunnyBirds work and removes citations to Gu and Dao's Mamba, Vaswani, and Parchami-Araghi et al.'s explanation-enhanced distillation. The principal positioning relative to NW-Head, B-cos, and prototype-based models remains intact.

P1.justification: The title and method name change, two authors are added, and the abstract, background, and conclusion receive localized rewriting. Related Work and Contribution headings are introduced, but the main section sequence and most retained technical and case-study prose remain recognizable.

P2.justification: v2 adopts two-column formatting, substantially redraws Figure 1, removes v1's comparison diagram, and retains its architecture diagram as Figure 2. It adds accuracy and FunnyBirds displays, restructures Table A.2, relocates Figure 4 beside its discussion, and repacks appendix figures. Previously blank RSNA test-attribution panels become visibly populated.

improvement.justification: v1 supports interpretability mainly through proofs and selected examples, with accuracy comparisons limited to black-box models. v2's controlled FunnyBirds tests and interpretable baselines substantially strengthen empirical assessment of the paper's central contribution. These gains outweigh limited reporting problems: the RSNA repeatability caution disappears, and Table A.4's ProtoPNet completeness of 0.75 conflicts with the stated averaging rule, whose listed components average 0.835.
